title: Turtle Shell Divine Light
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's guidance points to a forbidden place—the Ancient Bloodline Forbidden Land. There lie buried the deepest secrets of the Chen family's ancestors, and it also holds the key to reversing Heavenly Fate. However, those who enter the forbidden land must use bloodline as the key and lifespan as the sacrifice. How will Chen Ji make his choice?

text.content: Just as Chen Ji thought he was doomed to death, that broken turtle shell suddenly emitted a faint glow, as if responding to a call from the depths of his soul. A pale golden light seeped from the surface of the turtle shell, like an ancient beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years opening its eyes. He lowered his head to gaze at the turtle shell in his hand, and witnessed the originally mottled cracks healing at a speed visible to the naked eye, with ancient runes emerging on the shell's surface, radiating a chilling aura from a primordial era.

Chen Ji instinctively bit his fingertip, letting a drop of blood fall onto the turtle shell. What shocked him was that the drop of essence blood was instantly absorbed by the shell, as if an arid desert had finally received long-awaited nourishment. The turtle shell's radiance surged instantly, the originally dull surface becoming crystal clear, with rune patterns visible flowing within, moving like living things inside the shell.

dialogue.content: "Clever boy, you certainly know the right moment." An aged and familiar voice suddenly rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was the long-absent Mo Xiansheng. "This turtle shell has been slumbering for many years and finally awaits its true master. But this drop of your essence blood won't be enough to satisfy it."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom appeared beside Chen Ji. Although almost transparent and illusory, the turbid eyes were flickering with rare excitement. He stared at the turtle shell, his voice slightly trembling: "This is... the Life-Extending Ancient Rune! I thought this thing had been lost long ago!"

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment flew out on its own, standing opposite the turtle shell. Between the two existed an invisible bond, their rune lights intertwining to form a mysterious formation diagram. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his Brow Center, and countless pieces of unfamiliar information flooded into his mind like a tide—that was the ancient memory regarding this turtle shell's origin.

When Chen Ji's father Chen Xuan traveled the world, he discovered this turtle shell in an ancient ruin. In the ruins there was also a skeleton sitting in a meditative pose, holding this turtle shell in its hands. Chen Xuan took the shell but did not know that it sealed the complete essence blood inheritance of an ancient great being—as well as a forbidden technique called the "Heavenly Fate Life-Extending Art."

dialogue.content: "This life-extending ancient method is extraordinary," Mo Xiansheng's voice became grave. "It can extend life for three years for someone about to die, or extend lifespan by ten years for someone at death's door. However, every use requires a corresponding price." He paused, a complex light flickering in his turbid eyes, "Why your father didn't use this turtle shell back then, even I don't know. But he left it for you, which must have profound meaning."

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the turtle shell, feeling the warmth emanating from within. He closed his eyes and probed deep into the turtle shell with his spiritual sense. Among those mysterious runes, he discovered a hidden information seal—that was a spiritual sense imprint left by his father. Chen Ji used essence blood as the guide and forcibly activated the seal, and a familiar yet unfamiliar voice sounded in his mind.

dialogue.content: "Ji'er, if you can hear these words, it means your father is no longer among the living." His father's voice was aged and weary, yet carried an indescribable gentleness. "This turtle shell is called 'Heavenly Fate Turtle,' a divine artifact used in ancient times to record the evolution of Heavenly Secrets. When I obtained it, I originally intended to extend my own lifespan, but discovered a tremendous secret hidden within..."

text.content: His father's voice continued: "The Heavenly Fate Turtle and the Tianji Record are originally two sides of the same coin—one records the evolution of Heavenly Secrets, the other bears the cycle of Heavenly Fate. If you want the Tianji Record to become truly complete, you must use the Heavenly Fate Turtle as the foundation. And to activate the full power of the Heavenly Fate Turtle, you need to enter a forbidden place—the Ancient Bloodline Forbidden Land."

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, a flash of brilliant light within. The Ancient Bloodline Forbidden Land—he had heard this name in the occasional words revealed by Mo Xiansheng. It was a perilous domain that even great beings dared not easily tread. Yet now, he learned from his father's legacy that the key to perfecting the Tianji Record lay hidden there.

dialogue.content: "What your father said is correct," Mo Xiansheng nodded, "The Ancient Bloodline Forbidden Land does indeed exist, and it buries the bloodline inheritances of many ancient great beings. However, this forbidden land is sealed by the Heavenly Dao Will, and those who forcibly enter are doomed to die. Unless..." His voice became meaningful, "Unless one possesses a token recognized by the Bloodline Forbidden Land, or opens the seal in a specific way."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Heavenly Fate Turtle in his hand, deep in thought. He probed deep into the turtle shell with his spiritual sense and discovered that at the center of those ancient runes was赫然铭刻着一个微小的印记—a minute imprint—namely a blood-colored phoenix spreading its wings to fly, identical to the emblem on the Chen family ancestral crest. So this Heavenly Fate Turtle was originally a token brought out from the Bloodline Forbidden Land by the Chen family's ancestors.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng explained in detail the price of the life-extending ancient method and the possible paths to enter the Bloodline Forbidden Land, and Chen Ji needed to make a decision.

choices.text: Immediately Activate the Life-Extending Ancient Method
choices.description: While the turtle shell has just awakened, immediately use the life-extending ancient method to stabilize the injuries and buy time for subsequent actions. The price is the consumption of the essence blood inheritance sealed within the turtle shell.
choices.visible_cost: Consume the essence blood inheritance sealed within the turtle shell, and the turtle shell may fall into slumber
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize injuries, extend life by three years, greatly restore combat power
choices.risk_hint: After the turtle shell falls into slumber, it may affect subsequent entry into the Bloodline Forbidden Land

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer, bit the tip of his tongue, used essence blood as the guide, and injected his spiritual energy into the turtle shell. The turtle shell instantly erupted with dazzling light, countless runes rotating and flying in the air, forming a massive formation that enveloped him. A warm force flowed into his limbs and torso, and those meridians damaged from burning Heavenly Fate Value were healing at a visible speed.

choices.description: The turtle shell has just awakened, and the essence blood inheritance within is extremely precious. It would be better to seal it first, and only use it when entering the Bloodline Forbidden Land, which may have an unexpected effect.
choices.visible_cost: Not immediately recovering from injuries may affect recent battles
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the turtle shell's complete power, adding a trump card for the Bloodline Forbidden Land journey
choices.risk_hint: Unhealed injuries may encounter danger in the following situation

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment and decided to temporarily seal the turtle shell's power. He laid a layer of seal on the turtle shell's surface with spiritual energy, re-sealing those awakened runes back into a slumbering state. The turtle shell's light gradually收敛, becoming dim and lifeless again, but he could feel the majestic power contained within was蛰伏, waiting for the moment to be awakened.

choices.description: Before making a decision, he should first learn more about the Bloodline Forbidden Land and the specific methods to enter the forbidden land. Since Mo Xiansheng knows these secrets, perhaps there are other hidden truths.
choices.visible_cost: Spending time understanding the situation may miss the best timing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Bloodline Forbidden Land, providing a basis for subsequent decisions
choices.risk_hint: The information may be incomplete, or Mo Xiansheng may be hiding something

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng slightly nodded, a flash of appreciation flickering in his eyes: "Good question." His voice became low, "The Ancient Bloodline Forbidden Land opens once every ten thousand years. The next opening is in three years. And the Heavenly Fate Turtle left by your father is precisely the key to entering the forbidden land. However..." He hesitated to speak further, "Entering the forbidden land is easy, but surviving to exit is as difficult as ascending to heaven."

choices.memory_label: 墨先生对陈机的谨慎态度表示认可

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, another of his father's spiritual sense imprints surfaced from the depths of the turtle shell. This time, the imprint contained not only sound but also a blurry image—a land of blood, countless strong men's bones piled like mountains, and above the mountain of bones and sea of blood, a majestic stone door stood among the clouds, radiating a chilling might.

Chen Ji gazed at that stone door, an indescribable emotion welling in his heart. He recognized the door's style—it was precisely the sealed forbidden land entrance deep within the Chen family ancestral land. For generations, the Chen family's ancestors had tried to open that door, yet not a single person succeeded. Now he finally understood, the key had always been in his hands, only never discovered.

dialogue.content: "Father..." Chen Ji softly murmured, his fingertips gently brushing over the blood phoenix imprint on the turtle shell. He suddenly remembered during his childhood, his father once held him standing before the Chen family ancestral land, pointing to that sealed stone door and saying: "Ji'er, inside lies the root of our Chen family's prosperity, and also the root of our Chen family's decline." Back then he didn't understand the deep meaning in his father's words, but now he completely understood.

choice.prompt: The information left by his father was immense, and Chen Ji needed to sort out his thoughts and decide the next course of action.

choices.text: Immediately Return to the Chen Family Ancestral Land
choices.description: Since he now knows the entrance to the Bloodline Forbidden Land is in the Chen family ancestral land, he should return as soon as possible and get ahead of the enemies before they react.
choices.visible_cost: Injuries unhealed, long-distance travel may increase the burden
choices.visible_reward: Get ahead and enter the Bloodline Forbidden Land, gaining the first-mover advantage
choices.risk_hint: The Tianqing Sect may become aware, and ambushes may be encountered on the road

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, a decisive light flashing in his eyes. He had made his decision—he must return to the Chen family ancestral land as soon as possible. There was not only the entrance to the Bloodline Forbidden Land but also all the secrets of his origins hidden there. Those forces that had always coveted the Chen family in the shadows would never allow him to succeed easily.

choices.description: Haste makes waste; with injuries unhealed, acting recklessly will only put oneself in a passive position. Better to first find a safe place, use the life-extending ancient method to stabilize injuries, then plan for the long term.
choices.visible_cost: Need to find a safe location, may take several days
choices.visible_reward: Injuries fully healed, face subsequent challenges in optimal condition
choices.risk_hint: Within those days, situations may change, and opportunities are fleeting

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the urgency in his heart. He knew he had to stay calm; acting rashly would only complicate the situation further. He looked around, searching for a place where he could safely heal. Finally, his gaze fell upon an abandoned cave nearby—the spiritual energy there was thin, which could恰好 conceal his aura.

choices.description: In his current state, acting alone is too risky. Although Su Qingyao has been investigating him, she is after all the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect. If he could borrow her strength, perhaps he could return to the ancestral land more smoothly.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his whereabouts, letting more people know about the turtle shell's existence
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful support, reducing the risk of the journey
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may interrogate about the turtle shell's origin

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a communication jade slip from his怀中, which Su Qingyao had given him back then for convenient contact. He hesitated for a moment but still injected spiritual energy into the jade slip. After a while, Su Qingyao's cold voice came through: "Chen Ji? You're still alive?" Her tone carried a hint of subtle concern, "Where are you now? I sensed your aura is extremely weak—are you in trouble?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng watched Chen Ji make his decision, his remnant soul phantom flickering slightly, as if there were words he wanted to say but hesitated. After a long while, he sighed and said: "Forget it, what needed to be said has been said, the remaining road you must walk alone. However, there is one thing I must remind you—" His voice became grave, "Within the Bloodline Forbidden Land, not only the bloodlines of ancient great beings are buried, but also their grudges and obsessions. Everyone who enters the forbidden land must face the thing they fear most in the depths of their heart. If you cannot pass that trial, even with the Heavenly Fate Turtle protecting you, you will only become another pile of bones in the forbidden land."

He raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon—that was the direction of the Chen family ancestral land. His eyes were calm yet resolute, as if he had already seen the endpoint of fate.
